description: This PHP source file defines the MigrationAPI class within the OrangeHRM installer API namespace. It extends another migration API class and overrides the handleGet method to return migration map keys.

classes.name: MigrationAPI
classes.description: API controller class for handling migration-related API requests during installation, extending the base migration API class and customizing the GET request handling.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests and returns the list of migration keys from the application's setup utility.
